filters.basis: Note E or R marks a probable HII region or background galaxy, and 'other' an object excluded as a planetary nebula by its flux (ReadMe note 1).
The survey of M31 marks the host of each object that is not M31's own (ReadMe note 2); these are the rows it gives to M110, without those it marks as uncertain.

frame.converter: Each sky position onto the plane the picture stands on, facing the Sun (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

meaning: Planetary nebulae of M110 from Merrett et al.'s (2006) survey of M31 with the Planetary Nebula Spectrograph, which marks them as this galaxy's: one dot per nebula at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the planetary-nebula color M31's and M33's dots share. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
